subject: PERF: stop reading a post for every like on the topic being read

proofs.name: ten likes from other readers read no post
the echo of the reader's own like reads no post
the echo arriving after the write reads no post

subject: PERF: stop reading the whole topic after a saved bookmark

proofs.name: saving a post bookmark does not read the topic
saving a topic bookmark does not read the topic
editing a bookmark does not read the topic
deleting a bookmark does not read the topic
clearing a topic's bookmarks does not read the topic

subject: PERF: stop mounting a link around each heading's invisible anchor

proofs.name: an empty heading anchor costs no link machinery

subject: PERF: draw a code fence as one paragraph, not a row per line

proofs.name: a fence costs one paragraph rather than a row per line

subject: PERF: mount a desktop image's metadata bar only once it is shown

proofs.name: a desktop image mounts its metadata bar only once it is shown

proofs.name: a message as the server publishes it leaves an idle channel composer alone
a reply as the server publishes it leaves an idle thread composer alone

subject: PERF: stop rewriting the tab document while a list or topic scrolls

proofs.name: scrolling a topic list writes its resting anchor once
scrolling a topic writes its resting anchor once

subject: PERF: write the phone workspace once per navigation

proofs.name: a phone writes its workspace once per navigation

subject: PERF: stop redrawing a date countdown every second
